author: The Current
description:
Watch The Union feat. Phil Cook perform "Still Have Joy" live in an Eau Claire coffeehouse
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

The Union feat. Phil Cook taking people to church on a Saturday morning in Eau Claire! 

On Saturday, July 25, just one day after performing an uplifting set at the Eaux Claires Festival at Carson Park, The Union feat. Phil Cook showed up bright and early at SHIFT Coffee Bar in Eau Claire, Wisconsin,  to a set of three songs, including "Still Have Joy," above. 

When the Eaux Claires Festival returned in the summer of 2026, The Current and Radio Milwaukee teamed up for a live broadcast from SHIFT, and this performance was part of that series of broadcasts. 

Find their full set here: https://www.thecurrent.org/feature/2026/09/30/the-union-feat-phil-cook-perform-live-at-shift-in-eau-claire

Simone Appleby – keyboards, vocals
Phil Cook – guitar, vocals

When the Eaux Claires Festival returned in the summer of 2026, The Current and Radio Milwaukee teamed up for a live broadcast from Shift Coffee Bar in Eau Claire, Wisconsin.

On Saturday, July 25, just one day after performing an uplifting set at the Eaux Claires Festival at Carson Park, The Union feat. Phil Cook showed up bright and early at SHIFT to a set of three songs, including the original, "There Was a Time," off their 2025 album, "Eclectic."
